name: Sauerkraut
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as cabbage is low FODMAP. The fermentation process may aid digestion and provide beneficial probiotics for gut health.
preparationTips: Choose brands without high FODMAP additives like onion or garlic
Start with smaller portions if sensitive to fermented foods
Rinse with water if concerned about sodium content
Store opened jars in refrigerator and consume within recommended timeframe
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and K
